errors.refundExceeds: The refund exceeds what is left of the original purchase: confirm it to record it.

splits.title: Categories (splits)

bulk.title: Bulk edit of {n} transactions
bulk.tagsHint: Hold Ctrl or Cmd to pick several.

filters.title: Transaction filters
filters.withoutStatementHint: Transactions marked as reconciled without a statement.

detail.duplicateNotice: Recorded. Note: it looks like another movement with the same account and amount (±3 days); check it is not a duplicate.
detail.reconcile: Mark as reconciled without a statement

void.title: Void this transaction?
void.description: A reversal entry is recorded; the transaction is not deleted and stays in the history.

unreconcile.title: Unreconcile this transaction?
unreconcile.description: It goes back to cleared so it can be corrected. The reason is audited.

reconcile.title: Mark as reconciled without a statement?
reconcile.description: Use it when there is no statement to check it against (cash, wallets). It stays flagged "pending review" until a later reconciliation verifies it. Balances do not change.

done.reconcile: Transaction marked as reconciled without a statement.
done.amended: Changes saved: reversal and new entry (revision {revision}).

history.title: History (lifecycle)
history.subtitle: Every change of this transaction: from which status to which, who, when and why.
history.revision: Ledger revision {from} → {to}: previous entry reversed and new entry posted.

transfer.title: Transfer between own accounts
transfer.intro: Move money between your accounts in the same currency: it is neither income nor expense (the fee is an expense).
transfer.cardIntro: The payment reduces the card debt and the source account balance; it is not counted as an expense.
transfer.mismatch: The accounts have different currencies ({from} → {to}): this is a conversion, not a transfer.
transfer.feeHint: Charged to the source account and recorded as an expense (Fees).

RECONCILED_WITHOUT_STATEMENT.label: Reconciled without a statement — pending review
RECONCILED_WITHOUT_STATEMENT.hint: Marked as reconciled without a statement: it stays pending review until a later reconciliation verifies it.

pricing.noSpread: Cannot be computed without a reference
pricing.incomplete: incomplete: some amounts could not be valued
pricing.deviationText: The quoted rate does not match the amounts (difference {amount}); the real amounts are recorded.

detail.title: Conversion detail (revision {revision})
detail.accountingNote: A single entry balanced per currency (FX trading accounts); fees are expenses in their own currency.

form.title: New conversion
form.intro: Enter two of three values (amount delivered, amount received or quoted rate) and compute the third before recording.
form.targetAmountHint: Net: what actually reaches the account.
form.referenceHint: Used for the spread; by default, the pair's preferred rate at that time.
form.summaryStale: You changed data: compute the summary again before recording.

errors.sameCurrency: Choose an account in another currency (same currency means a transfer).

amount.INVALID: This is not a valid amount.
amount.NOT_POSITIVE: The amount must be greater than zero.

rate.INVALID: This is not a valid rate.

rate.NOT_POSITIVE: The rate must be greater than zero.

errors.twoOfThree: Enter at least two of: amount delivered, amount received and quoted rate.
errors.executedAt: Enter a valid date and time.
errors.samePair: Base and quote currencies must be different.
errors.reasonMin: The reason needs at least 3 characters.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.corrected: Rate {pair} corrected: the previous version is kept as superseded.
rates.preferenceHint: Used for valuation and as the reference of conversions.
rates.noPreference: No preference (most recent of any type)

providers.title: Market rate providers
providers.intro: The system queries paralelo.bo (primary) and bo.dolarapi.com (fallback and official) in the background, without sending your data. If they fail, the last known rate marked as stale or your manual rates are used.
providers.retryAfter: Waiting for the usage limit until
providers.disabled: Disabled by configuration: not queried; the rest of the system keeps working with manual rates.
providers.quoteSidesHint: Buy: what you pay to buy 1 {base}. Sell: what you get when selling it. Only used when requested.

valuation.title: Current valuation rate
valuation.hint: Used to value balances and as conversion reference: primary → fallback → last known (stale) or manual.
valuation.none: no rate available (record a manual one)

anomalies.title: Anomalies pending review ({n})
anomalies.hint: Samples that moved more than the threshold vs the previous one: not used until you confirm them. Once rejected, never used.
anomalies.readOnly: Read only: an editor or owner of the workspace can confirm or reject them.
anomalies.confirmed: Anomaly confirmed: {rate} is now used for valuation.
anomalies.rejected: Anomaly rejected: {rate} will not be used.

errors.REASON_MIN: The reason must have at least 3 characters.
errors.REASON_MAX: The reason allows up to 500 characters.

Classification.title: Classification
Classification.catalogApplied: Suggested catalog applied (only what was missing was added).
Classification.name: Name
Classification.catalogHint: The suggested catalog adds common groups and categories for Bolivia; it only creates what is missing (by name) and you can edit or archive them later.
Classification.reorderHint: To reorder, use the ↑ and ↓ buttons of each category (keyboard) or drag it onto another one at the same level.
Classification.systemNameHint: System categories cannot be renamed; you can change their icon, color and order.
Classification.defaultCategoryHint: Suggested when recording a transaction with this counterparty.
Classification.aliasesHint: Texts it appears with in bank descriptions, comma separated (at least 3 characters each).

errors.ALIAS_MIN: Each alias must have between 3 and 120 characters.

Lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
Lifecycle.subtitle: This item's path through its state machine: each transition, who made it and when.

diagram.label: State diagram: current state {current}. Path: {path}.
diagram.legend: Highlighted: states and transitions taken, numbered in the order they happened (record is the entry point). Dimmed: not taken. The timeline describes the same path.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.derivedHint: Rebuilt from the audit log (before transitions were recorded).

Demo.title: Demo data
Demo.description: Loads realistic-looking fictitious financial data into a NEW demo workspace. This workspace is not modified.
Demo.inDemo: This is a demo workspace. You can fully clean it up at any time.
Demo.loadConfirmBody: A separate demo workspace will be created with you as its only owner. Your real data does not change.
Demo.failed: Loading demo data failed. Clean it up and try again.
Demo.cleanupConfirmBody: The demo workspace will become unavailable immediately and all its data will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
Demo.disabled: Loading demo data is disabled in this environment.

Planning.title: Financial periods
Planning.intro: Each period runs from the financial month start day to the day before that day in the next month, and is created automatically in advance. Today in your workspace: {today}.
Planning.caption: Workspace periods, newest first
Planning.empty: There are no periods yet: they are created automatically within a few minutes.

CustomFields.title: Custom fields
CustomFields.intro: Define your own data for transactions (per split) and accounts: invoice number, cost center, branch… They never affect balances or ledger entries.
CustomFields.empty: There are no custom fields yet.
CustomFields.label: Label
CustomFields.keyHint: Stable lowercase identifier (letters, digits and underscore). It cannot change later.
CustomFields.lockedHint: The type and the entity cannot change once the field has values.

errors.optionsRequired: A selection needs at least one option.
errors.optionKeyInvalid: An option key uses lowercase letters, digits and underscore (up to 40 characters).
errors.optionKeyDuplicated: Options cannot repeat a key or a label.
errors.INVALID_INTEGER: Enter a whole number of up to 15 digits.
errors.INVALID_DECIMAL: Enter a valid decimal (up to 18 decimals).

Reconciliation.title: Reconcile {account}
Reconciliation.intro: Check the account against a statement balance at a date: confirm the transactions that appear on the statement and finish when the difference is zero.
Reconciliation.introLiability: Check the card or loan against its statement. Balances are expressed as a positive debt, like on the statement.
Reconciliation.inProgressElsewhere: A reconciliation is in progress: open it from the history.
Reconciliation.noStart: There is no reconciliation in progress for this account.

start.title: Start a reconciliation
start.intro: Enter the date and balance shown on the statement. Only one reconciliation can be in progress per account.
start.liabilityHint: For a card or loan, enter the debt as a positive number.

errors.INVALID: The statement balance is not a valid number.
errors.SCALE: The balance has more decimals than the currency allows.
errors.NOT_POSITIVE: The statement balance is not valid.

hint.POSITIVE: The statement exceeds what is confirmed by {amount}. Confirm the missing transactions or finish with an adjustment.
hint.NEGATIVE: What is confirmed exceeds the statement by {amount}. Unconfirm what is not on the statement or finish with an adjustment.

list.title: Transactions up to {date}
list.label: Account transactions up to the statement date
list.help: Mark as confirmed the ones that appear on the statement. The cleared balance and the difference update instantly.
list.readOnly: This reconciliation no longer accepts changes.
list.completedItems: This reconciliation reconciled or verified {n} transactions.
list.empty: There are no transactions to confirm up to that date.

adjustment.title: The difference is not zero

description.INCREASE: An increase adjustment of {amount} will be created against the equity adjustment account, dated on the statement date, and reconciled with the rest.
description.DECREASE: A decrease adjustment of {amount} will be created against the equity adjustment account, dated on the statement date, and reconciled with the rest.

adjustment.reasonHint: Required. It is audited (for example: unrecorded bank fee).

cancel.title: Cancel this reconciliation?
cancel.description: The transactions you confirmed stay confirmed and you can start another reconciliation.

done.completed: Reconciliation finished: the confirmed transactions are now reconciled.

history.title: Reconciliation history

Budgets.title: Budgets
Budgets.intro: Plan each period with expected income and budgets by category, group or tag. Spending is always computed from your transactions; it is never edited by hand.
Budgets.noPeriods: There are no periods yet: they are created automatically. Check the periods section.
Budgets.periodClosed: This period is closed: its plan is read-only. An owner can reopen it to correct it.
Budgets.noPlan: This period does not have a plan yet.

totals.title: Plan summary
totals.availableHint: Adds up what is left in each category or group budget; an overspend does not reduce the others.
totals.incomplete: Spending is incomplete: some amounts have no valid exchange rate.
totals.unconverted: Not converted: {amounts}. They are never estimated at 1:1.

lines.title: Plan lines
lines.caption: Plan lines with planned and spent amounts and their status
lines.empty: The plan has no lines yet. Add a budget by category, group or tag.
lines.confirmRemoveBody: The spending is not lost: it just stops being measured in this plan. Thresholds already notified are not notified again if you add the line back.

form.titleAdd: Add a line to the plan
form.incomeFixedOnly: Expected income only admits a fixed amount and has no thresholds.
form.percentHint: Greater than 0 and up to 100, with up to 4 decimals.
form.thresholdsHint: Comma separated, up to 10 values between 0 and 1000. Empty uses 50, 75, 90 and 100.

errors.scale: It has more decimals than the currency allows.

widget.title: Budget of the month
widget.incomplete: Some expenses have no exchange rate: the spent amount may be higher.
widget.noPlan: This period does not have a plan yet: there is no available-to-spend amount to show.

origin.title: Where the plan comes from
origin.CLONE_PREVIOUS: Clone the plan of the previous month
origin.cloneHint: The lines of the previous month are copied, without spent amounts or thresholds already alerted.

omitted.title: Some lines were not copied
omitted.TARGET_ARCHIVED: {name}: its category, group or tag is archived.
omitted.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: {name}: it is in a different currency than the plan.

originInfo.CLONE: Origin: cloned from the previous month plan.
originInfo.CLONE_TEMPLATE: Origin: cloned from the previous month plan (template {name}, version {versionNo}).

propagate.createTemplate: Create a template with these lines
propagate.noOrigin: This plan does not come from a template, so it cannot be propagated.
propagate.selectHint: Pick the lines you want to carry to the template and to the future draft months.
propagate.createHint: A template will be created with the {count} lines of this plan. You can then apply it to other months.
propagate.applied: Changes propagated to the future months.

Budgets.lineMissing: The budget line that triggered the notification no longer exists in this plan.

Templates.title: Budget templates
Templates.intro: A template stores the lines of a monthly plan in immutable versions. Apply it when creating the plan of a period, or make it the default so every new period starts with its plan.
Templates.empty: There are no templates yet. Create one to reuse your planning month after month.

create.title: New template
create.name: Name
create.done: Template created. Add its lines and publish the next version.

archive.title: Archive the template {name}?
archive.body: It stops being the default and can no longer be applied. Its versions and the plans already created do not change.

draft.title: Version {versionNo} (draft)
draft.intro: Edit the lines and publish: a new, complete version is created; version {versionNo} does not change.

clone.title: Clone as a new template
clone.intro: Version {versionNo} is copied as an independent template with its own version 1.
clone.name: Name of the clone

propagation.title: Apply to future months
propagation.intro: Only the plans of future draft periods are updated. Lines you edited by hand are not touched. Nothing changes until you confirm.
propagation.newVersion: Version {versionNo} of the template will be published: {added} lines added, {updated} changed and {removed} removed.
propagation.noPeriods: There are no plans of future draft periods that follow this template.

reason.MANUAL_LINE: it is a line of the plan itself
reason.TARGET_OVERLAP: it would overlap another line of the plan
reason.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: the plan is in another currency

propagation.done: Propagation applied: the new template version was published and the plans were updated.

Closing.title: Month close
Closing.intro: Review the period checklist, explicitly acknowledge any warnings and close it. Closing locks movements dated in the period and stores an immutable version of the report.
Closing.noPeriods: There are no periods to close yet.
Closing.periodNotFound: We could not find that period in your workspace.
Closing.closedOk: Month {name} closed. Version {closeNo} of the close was saved.
Closing.reopenedOk: Period {name} reopened. Closing it again will create a new version of the close.
Closing.notClosable: A period in status “{status}” cannot be closed.
Closing.notEnded: The period ends on {end}: you can close it from the next day.

kinds.RECONCILED_WITHOUT_STATEMENT: Reconciled without a statement — pending review

Closing.notAvailable: This check is not available yet: it does not block the close.
Closing.withoutStatementHint: These transactions are reconciled without a statement: they do not block the close nor require acknowledgement, but remain pending review.

checklist.warningsOnly: There are only warnings: you can close if you explicitly acknowledge them.

blocked.ROLE: Your role (read-only) does not allow closing the month.

blocked.ACK_REQUIRED: Tick the warning acknowledgement to be able to close.

errors.TOO_LONG: The reason allows up to {max} characters.
